Disciplina arcani

Glossary

Disciplina arcani

Discipline of the secret

The historical restriction on disclosing the Creed and sacramental mysteries to people not yet admitted to that instruction. Gifford’s note 437 uses this name for the practice addressed in Cyril’s Procatechesis. It identifies an ancient setting, not a secrecy rule imposed by the app.
